extracted.name: Whipped Ricotta
extracted.description: This creamy whipped ricotta dip is an easy, elegant appetizer. Garnish it with honey, lemon, and fresh herbs, and serve with crackers or crostini. Store leftover dip in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the ricotta, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt and process until light and smooth, 1 to 2 minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with a drizzle of olive oil, honey, lemon zest, thyme, and flakey sea salt. Serve with grilled baguette or crostini.
